answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before it can vouch for another, and let trust grow only from completed work that both sides countersign. A pearl of reputation earned this way cannot be faked cheaply: each fake identity is a relic with no history, forced to fund its own deposit and build its own record before it can attest, like a ship earning entry to a harbor one verified voyage at a time. False attestation slashes the deposit and burns the record, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand deposits while honest agents keep their standing.
